description.p: Zeidex Convert is a powerful offline file converter and media processor. Convert and process video, audio, images, documents, and archives completely on your local machine with zero uploads.
برنامج Zeidex Convert هو منظومة قوية لتحويل ومعالجة الملفات والوسائط محلياً دون أي اتصال بالإنترنت مع خصوصية وسرية تامة.

Offline conversion on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android
تحويل محلي على ويندوز وماك ولينكس وأندرويد

description.p: Image conversion, resizing, cropping, rotation and compression fall back to the bundled FFmpeg when libvips is absent, so every package converts images out of the box. The window has a full-width title bar with its controls, the sidebar no longer scrolls with the page, settings gain a tray-icon switch, and the popup wheel is smaller and hides itself when untouched. Linux ships one per-user AppImage and Windows one per-user setup that needs no administrator rights.
LocalDrop file transfer, secure shredder, PII redaction and AI upscale; installers for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.
